assumptions: Retains the original launch assembly fuel and oxidizer inventory without changing tank loading. Continuous detached Super Heavy return using the inherited estimated Flight 12 V3 hardware. Landing feed inventory is isolated within the original aggregate tank at initial assembly, remains part of wet mass, and is opened without refilling after main-feed exhaustion. This is a resource partition, not a measured header-tank location or feed-pressure model. Reserve, Gulf aim point, boostback steering, descent gains and burn gates are engineering estimates. Source-backed engine counts are 31 and 11/5/3; no engine fault identities are inferred. Actual propagated water contact is observed independently of Starship, with no tower catch, trajectory reseed or timed landing shutdown. After a three-second engineering water-observation window, the source-backed FTS event retires the booster from further propagation. This estimated delay is not measured FTS timing; explosive energy and fragments are not simulated. Sealed-cylinder water response excludes flooding, waves and structural breakup from FTS.
